items.title: Context doesn't live in a chat box, so Nothing built an AI gadget with no screen
items.excerpt: Carl Pei's nine-second video shows the face of Nothing's first AI-native device: a brushed-metal slab with one big button, a red dot and two glowing pills, no screen. Ships in December; still no name or price.
items.note: Follow-up to the 11-05 teaser; adds the first look at the hardware design but no name or price yet

items.title: This chatty robot turns your kid's doodles into new pictures
items.excerpt: WhalesBot's Pubbo, an AI companion robot for kids aged 3 to 11, draws what a child describes out loud on its 3.5-inch screen face and talks back. It uses a 5MP camera for visual recognition, just went on sale in the US at $299.99, and is a holiday AI toy pick.

items.title: The family 3D printer that turns phone photos into toys
items.excerpt: QIDI's $349 MakeBuddy Smart5 is an enclosed 3D printer for family rooms. It has an AI camera, and an AI photo-to-3D app turns phone snapshots into printable toy models.

items.title: I tested the Halliday G2 AI smart glasses and they turned me into a walking 'cheat sheet' — but everyone could tell
items.excerpt: A hands-on review of Halliday's camera-less G2 AI glasses. The AI features are useful, but the design looks dorky and people around you notice when you're reading answers off the display.
items.note: Non-Apple/non-Samsung smart glasses review; fits the smart-glasses slot

items.title: I tested Lenovo's Yoga 9n 2-in-1 against the MacBook Pro for two weeks — impressive OLED and AI smarts cannot make up for poor gaming
items.excerpt: Review of Lenovo's $2,999 ARM-and-Nvidia Windows 2-in-1, built to run AI models locally. The OLED and pen are excellent and local AI performance is strong, but gaming and raw performance trail the MacBook Pro.

items.title: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions
items.excerpt: The iOS 27.3 beta caps daily use of the more complex Siri AI and Apple Intelligence requests on each device, and iCloud+ tiers raise the limits. Basic Siri requests stay free and unlimited.
items.note: Same news is on MacRumors and 9to5Mac; keep one

items.title: You can now ask Siri AI questions about your health data, with iOS 27.3 beta 2
items.excerpt: iOS 27.3 beta 2 lets Siri AI answer questions about data in the Health app. That opens one of the last areas the new on-device assistant had stayed out of.

items.title: iOS 27.3 Adds 'Ask About Page' Siri AI Feature to Safari
items.excerpt: In iOS 27.3 beta 2, Siri AI can read a whole webpage in Safari, including parts not on screen, and answer questions about it, such as listing every option on a long menu.

items.title: macOS 27.3 Warns Against Giving AI Apps Full Mac Control
items.excerpt: The macOS 27.3 beta changes the Full Disk Access API and adds warnings before users give AI-agent apps such as Claude broad control of their Mac.
items.note: OS-level device control of AI agents; borderline against the 'desktop agent apps 0' cap, but this is an OS feature, not an agent app

items.title: I Let My Apple Watch Eavesdrop on My Conversations for 2 Weeks
items.excerpt: A two-week hands-on with Audio Intelligence, the AI note-taking feature in watchOS 27.3 that listens to and summarizes conversations on the Apple Watch. The tester came away more worried about sanity than privacy.

items.title: Hasbro Is Using AI to Bring Characters to Life — With Limits
items.excerpt: Hasbro's Sixth Wall Studio is giving licensed characters like Cobra Commander conversational AI personas for toys, theme-park robots and video calls, with guardrails on what they will say.
items.note: AI toy/character angle; The Gadgeteer's 11-16 story covers the theme-park robot side

items.title: Apple launches private AI health study app — first-of-its-kind beta opens to 200,000 testers
items.excerpt: Apple and OpenEvidence opened a research app in which up to 200,000 iPhone users can talk to a custom AI about conditions and symptoms, a test of whether people trust AI health advice.
items.note: Lean on gadgets (an app, not hardware); medicine crossover

items.title: '안티 AI 커닝' 기술 속속 등장…전파차단부터 AI 답변 봉쇄까지
items.excerpt: AI 안경과 초소형 기기를 쓴 시험 부정행위가 늘면서 전파탐지, 전파차단, AI 안경 식별, AI 서비스의 시험 문제 풀이 제한 같은 '안티 AI 커닝' 기술이 주목받는다. 정부는 이번 수능에서 스마트안경을 착용만 해도 부정행위로 처리한다.
items.note: Korean AI-glasses angle; avoids the Samsung eyewear cap

items.title: [카드뉴스] AI안경 하나면 국가시험도 뚫릴까요
items.excerpt: 금속탐지기에도 잘 걸리지 않는 AI 안경이 시험 문제 글자를 읽어 AI에 보내고 답을 받는 방식이 세무사 시험 수석 합격자 의혹으로 쟁점이 됐다. 카드뉴스로 정리한 AI 안경 부정행위 이슈.
items.note: Same story as the etnews item; keep one

items.title: I run a 2B vision model on my phone and stopped sending my screenshots to ChatGPT and Claude
items.excerpt: A hands-on with a 2-billion-parameter vision model running fully on a phone. It reads and sorts screenshots privately, without sending them to cloud chatbots.

items.title: What does an NPU do and why do so many laptops have them?
items.excerpt: An explainer on what the neural processing units in Copilot+ and other AI laptops actually do and whether buyers need one.
